body.name: \(\mathrm{CI}_n\)
body.construction: If \(\mathcal C_n\neq\varnothing\), set \(\mathrm{CI}_n:=[\inf_{\pi'\in\mathcal C_n}D_1(\pi')-\varepsilon_{\mathrm{num}},\ \sup_{\pi'\in\mathcal C_n}U_1(\pi')+\varepsilon_{\mathrm{num}}]\cap[0,1]\); if \(\mathcal C_n=\varnothing\), set \(\mathrm{CI}_n:=[0,1]\).
